source_text: Haec Libri Quarti prima series: a Surge, veni per hiemem transitam, flores, turturem, ficum et vitis odorem, usque ad vocationem egrediendi a carne. Sequitur plenius de ostensione faciei in petra et de vulpibus usque ad Amen commentarii superstitis.
pass_a_gloss: These of-Book Fourth first series: from Rise, come through winter passed, flowers, turtledove, fig and of-vine odor, as-far-as to calling of-going-out from flesh. Follows more-fully concerning showing of-face in rock and concerning foxes as-far-as to Amen of-commentary surviving.
pass_b_english: This is the Fourth Book’s first series: from Arise, come through winter past, flowers, turtledove, fig and the vine’s fragrance, as far as the call to go out from the flesh. What follows more fully treats showing the face in the rock and the foxes, as far as Amen at the end of the surviving commentary.
notes: Next Liber IV §§11+ CLOSEOUT foxes Amen.
